name: medibridge-mobile
description: Capacitor shell + web asset build for the MediBridge SPA in ../ui

scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npm run prepare:www && cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.android:apk: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
scripts.ios:sim: npm run sync && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -configuration Debug CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
